actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, socket

BASE = "/var/lib/failover"

def atomic_write(path, data):
    """Durably write file: temp + fsync + rename + dir fsync (atomic switch)."""
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    fd = os.open(tmp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
    try:
        os.write(fd, data.encode())
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.rename(tmp, path)
    dfd = os.open(BASE, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dfd)
    finally:
        os.close(dfd)

# 0) Preconditions: old primary must be down, replica healthy, failed marker present
s = socket.socket()
s.settimeout(1)
assert s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 8081)) != 0, "PORT 8081 IS LISTENING - ABORT"

actions.command:
set -e
cd /var/lib/failover
# Durable fence of the old primary (8081 is not listening; keep it that way)
touch primary.fenced
# Promote replica atomically
printf 'primary\n' > .replica.role.tmp && sync .replica.role.tmp && mv -f .replica.role.tmp replica.role && sync replica.role
# Switch proxy upstream atomically
printf '8082\n' > .upstream.tmp && sync .upstream.tmp && mv -f .upstream.tmp upstream && sync upstream
sync
ls -la; echo ---; cat replica.role upstream; echo ---; ss -tln | grep -E '808[012]'
